notes.title: Update: v0.13 - Big update
notes.content:
[h1]New[/h1]
Added global inventory (Store items, Take items with you, Sell items)
Added game currency($)
Added item store
Added Game map system
Added New game map
Added New starting game map
Added Name and description of items
Added New icons for items
Added artifacts (items for sale)
Added closed door on a key card of a certain color
Added map instability system
Improved interface

[h1]New items[/h1]
Map data
Energy drink
Flashlight
Key cards
Black sludge (Formed)
Detector (items)
Detector (entities)
Dematerializer
A few artifacts

In general, there were many more changes, but they are not significant.

notes.title: Update: v0.03 - Regions, Achievements, Stats...
notes.content:
[b] - Added highlighting of objects with interaction
 - Fixed the effect of matter for other players in the game (not server owners)
 - Added a region system for the server host
 - Fixed a bug with AI, it did not see the player when he crouched down
 - Added statistics and achievements
 - Several important changes
[/b]

[h2]feel free to ask any questions, suggestions and everything else, we need more feedback to improve the game!
Thank you! [/h2]
